rationale: The short thesis remains mechanically intact — price holds below both VWAP ($15.52) and the declining 9-EMA ($15.54), relative volume is still 5.78x on a day BZ lags SPY, and no new headline has emerged to challenge the move. The tight, low-volume consolidation at $15.48-15.51 reads as a pause beneath resistance rather than accumulation, and adverse excursion has stayed minimal (-0.10%) with risk to the $15.68 stop (~$122) well inside the remaining loss budget. With price only 27% up the range and the $15.29 low still untested, there is no evidence yet — no VWAP reclaim, no uptick in buying volume — that justifies closing, and nothing remotely supportive of flipping long.
